# Kernel parameters shared by every boot profile that isolates CPUs.
# post-image.sh adds the CPU sets of the profile after these:
#   isolcpus=domain,managed_irq,<live>  nohz_full=<tickless>
#   rcu_nocbs=<tickless>  irqaffinity=<io>  dawos.profile=<name>
# (see rootfs-overlay/usr/share/dawos/profiles/*.conf).

# Spread the periodic ticks of the CPUs in time instead of firing them
# all at once: fewer CPUs contend for the same locks at the same instant.
skew_tick=1

# Do not run the periodic check of the time-stamp counter against another
# clock. On this class of processor the kernel already trusts the counter
# (constant, non-stop, known frequency); said here so that a kernel that
# decided otherwise would not start a timer that walks over every CPU.
tsc=reliable

# Not here, on purpose: nowatchdog, nosoftlockup, nmi_watchdog=0 (the
# kernel is built without the lockup detectors, the parameters would be
# unknown to it) and transparent_hugepage= (not available with PREEMPT_RT).
